newsitem.title: INDIA: Much of Delhi hit by power breakdown.
newsitem.headline: Much of Delhi hit by power breakdown.

text.p: Much of Delhi suffered a power breakdown on Wednesday following problems in northern India's power grid, but electricity was expected to be restored soon, officials said.
"Things are under control and the situation will be normalised in two hours," a spokesman for the Delhi Electric Supply Undertaking (DESU) told Reuters.

The Press Trust of India (PTI) said the breakdown was caused by a tripping of two units at a power station at Dadri, a town outside Delhi in Uttar Pradesh state, leading to a reduced power load in the capital.
The breakdown came two weeks after a major collapse of northern India's power grid.
